summary: Land acquisition compensation apportionment dispute; SLAO determination under Section 3H(3) of NHAI Act, 1956 based on civil court decree and revenue records; District Magistrate's interference under Section 3G(5) without jurisdiction and without hearing; HC upheld DM's order; SC holds DM lacks substantive revisionary powers, can only verify procedural compliance; interference with merits impermissible; impugned orders set aside; SLAO order reinstated.
legal_provisions_cited: National Highways Authority of India Act, 1956 s.3A
National Highways Authority of India Act, 1956 s.3D
National Highways Authority of India Act, 1956 s.3G(5)
National Highways Authority of India Act, 1956 s.3H(3)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court and District Magistrate's orders set aside; Special Land Acquisition Officer's apportionment order restored.
